transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess what brought me in is that some nights after work, or after a tense dinner, I start eating and it feels like I just… lose control. Like part of me knows I’m reaching for more food, but I can’t seem to make myself stop.
Do you usually feel guilty or ashamed after one of these eating episodes?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I don’t feel good about it afterward, but I haven’t really sorted out whether it’s guilt or shame exactly. It’s more just… I wish it hadn’t happened.
Do you ever try to make up for these eating episodes by doing something to counteract the calories?

Yeah. I don’t make myself throw up or anything, but after a night like that I’ll sometimes skip breakfast and lunch the next day. Or I’ll make myself walk for a long time before work. It’s not really because I want to exercise — it feels more like I have to cancel out what I did.
Have you ever made yourself throw up after one of these eating episodes?

Yes. Not every time, but there have been times after everyone’s gone to bed when I’ve gone to the bathroom and made myself throw up. I’ve also taken laxatives sometimes. In my head it’s like I’m trying to undo the damage, but afterward I feel really embarrassed and kind of shaky.
How often do these episodes of losing control and eating more than you intended happen?

For the last few months, it’s been most weeks. Usually it’s one night where I feel like I lose control and eat way more than I meant to, and then afterward I try to make up for it somehow — throwing up, laxatives, skipping meals, or making myself go on a long walk.
How often do you make yourself throw up after one of these eating episodes?

It’s not every time. Maybe some weeks it happens once, usually after everyone’s gone to bed. I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up, thinking I’m undoing what I did, but afterward I feel embarrassed and shaky.
How often do you take laxatives after one of these eating episodes?

I don’t do that every time either. It’s more like there have been some nights, after everyone’s asleep, where I’ll take laxatives because I’m telling myself I’m undoing the damage. Then afterward I usually feel embarrassed and kind of shaky.
How often do you have episodes where you feel like you're losing control and eating more than you intended, without trying to make up for it afterward?

It does happen. Some nights after work, or after a tense dinner, I’ll start eating and it’s like the decision-making part of me just shuts off. I can see myself reaching for more food, but I can’t make myself stop.
How often do you take laxatives after eating?

Like I said, it’s not every time. There have been nights after everyone’s gone to bed where I’ll take them because I’m telling myself I’m undoing the damage from eating. Then afterward I just feel embarrassed and kind of shaky.
How many times a month do you make yourself throw up after one of these eating episodes?

Maybe a few times a month. It’s usually late, after everyone’s asleep, and I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up because I’m telling myself I’m undoing what I ate. I feel pretty embarrassed afterward.
Do you use laxatives as often as you make yourself throw up after these eating episodes?

Probably about the same, maybe not exactly. Sometimes I make myself throw up, and other times I take laxatives after everyone’s gone to bed. In my head I’m telling myself I’m just undoing the damage, but afterward I feel embarrassed and kind of shaky.
How often do you have episodes where you lose control and eat more than you intended without doing anything to try to make up for it afterward?

Yeah… that happens too. Some nights after work, or after a tense dinner, I’ll start eating and it feels like the decision-making part of me just shuts off. I can see myself reaching for more food, but I can’t seem to make myself stop.
Do you take laxatives more often than you make yourself throw up after these eating episodes?

No, I don’t think it’s more often. It’s kind of split—sometimes I make myself throw up, and other times I take laxatives after everyone’s gone to bed. I tell myself I’m undoing the damage, but I usually feel embarrassed and shaky afterward.
How many times a week do you make yourself throw up after one of these eating episodes?

Usually a couple times a week. It tends to be after everyone’s gone to bed, and I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up, telling myself I’m undoing what I ate. I feel pretty embarrassed afterward.
Do you use laxatives as frequently as you make yourself throw up after eating episodes?

Yeah, I’d say they’re about the same. Some nights I make myself throw up, and other nights I use laxatives after everyone’s asleep. In my head I’m telling myself I’m just undoing the damage, but afterward I feel embarrassed and kind of shaky.
Do you use laxatives more frequently than you make yourself throw up after eating episodes?

No, not more frequently. It’s more like it varies—some nights after everyone’s asleep I’ll make myself throw up in the bathroom, and other times I’ll take laxatives. I tell myself it’s to undo the damage, but I usually feel embarrassed and shaky afterward.
Do you use laxatives or make yourself throw up more often after these eating episodes?

It’s kind of both, depending on the night. After one of those episodes, once everyone’s gone to bed, I might go to the bathroom and make myself throw up, or I’ll take laxatives. I tell myself it’s just to undo the damage, but afterward I feel embarrassed and shaky.
Do you use laxatives more often than you make yourself throw up after these episodes?

No, I don’t think the laxatives are more often. It’s more that after everyone’s asleep, sometimes I make myself throw up in the bathroom, and other times I take laxatives. I tell myself I’m undoing the damage, but afterward I feel embarrassed and shaky.
